name: tcm
description: Taekwondo Club Management — repository-level test orchestration. The app itself lives in server/ (.NET) and client/ (Angular); this file exists so the whole suite has one command.

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:client && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:api && npm run test:client
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e run install:browsers
